authority_status.pdf_statement: HTMLDisplayService is comparable to TimeService and defines no own protocol.
authority_status.device_integration: DeviceManagementService + DeviceClass MultiFunctionalDisplay; devices distinguished by DeviceID
authority_status.xsd_boundary: No dedicated HDS service XSD is selected. Relevant common enumerations/DMS structures are supporting dependencies only, not an invented HDS XML contract.

HDS_V2.1.fresh_read_rule: Do not open historical HDS findings until independent pinned-source fresh read and targeted visible review are frozen.
fresh_observations: The document explicitly says HtmlDisplayService defines no own protocol and is comparable to TimeService in that respect.
Discovery is DNS-SD based with service name HtmlDisplayService over _http._tcp.
TXT keys are content and path; path may include query or fragment.
The browser URL is formed as http://host:port/path using SRV host/port plus TXT path.
The content value is project-specific and not standardized by the document.
The document intentionally does not prescribe stable requirements for the served HTTP content/browser behavior.
Device integration uses DeviceManagementService with DeviceClass MultiFunctionalDisplay and DeviceID differentiation.
No dedicated HtmlDisplayService XSD exists in the checked official VDV-301-2.1 tag or integration branch.

runtime_evidence.scope: deterministic already-observed DNS-SD advertisements; no live DNS/mDNS claim
v2_1_checks: endpoint built from SRV target/port plus TXT path
